source_families.label: NYC Open Data portal datasets
source_families.notes: Use dataset-level metadata and API identifiers from NYC Open Data.

source_families.label: NYC orthophoto and aerial photo history
source_families.notes: Strongest open city orthophoto record per the PDF catalog; 2024-2026 captures not yet listed on the official tile service.

source_families.label: Global Landsat and Sentinel-2 archives
source_families.notes: Public-domain Landsat back to the 1970s and Copernicus Sentinel-2 from 2015 fill gaps between official aerial captures.

source_families.label: Parcel, lot, and 3D building baseline
source_families.notes: MapPLUTO provides tax-lot land use; Digital Tax Map provides parcel polygons; planimetrics/3D model add buildings (3D snapshot is 2014).

source_families.label: Department of Buildings filings, permits, and CO
source_families.notes: Three datasets cover the filing/permit lifecycle (Job Application Filings, BIS, DOB NOW Build); Certificate of Occupancy datasets approximate housing delivery.

source_families.label: Zoning, environmental review, and land-use documents
source_families.notes: ZAP and CEQR Access expose project search, environmental review documents, and historical records back to 1979.

source_families.label: Landmarks and preservation actions
source_families.notes: LPC permit and preservation records document administrative preservation actions and landmark-related status. They are not construction start, completion, compliance sign-off, final physical condition, or preservation outcome evidence.

source_families.label: HPD affordable housing production
source_families.notes: HPD production records support housing-production completion milestones where project/building IDs and coordinates are retained. Completion is administrative production evidence, not necessarily first occupancy or full project closeout.

source_families.label: Parks capital projects and public realm
source_families.notes: Parks tracker rows support capital-project status milestones where tracker IDs and completion dates are retained. They are not measured work footprints, opening dates, operating status, or outcome evidence.

source_families.label: DDC public building and civic project pages
source_families.notes: DDC pages support official public-building and project-stage evidence when source URLs, retrieval dates, and geometry-source notes are retained. Procurement and certification milestones are not construction, opening, occupancy, usage, or outcome evidence unless separately stated.

source_families.label: Street network and roadway geometry
source_families.notes: Centerline is the road-bed representation; LION remains the historic all-purpose street database.

source_families.label: DOT traffic counts and vehicle classification
source_families.notes: Periodic counts, not continuous sensors; volume archive plus 2011-2025 vehicle classification.

source_families.label: MTA developer feeds, ridership, and station access
source_families.notes: Static and live MTA feeds, plus annual turnstiles 2015-2022, hourly subway 2020-2024 and beginning-2025, daily 2020-2025, and entrances/exits.

source_families.label: 311 complaints and service requests
source_families.notes: Structured complaint exhaust 2010-present; minimize personal-text display when combining text, addresses, and sensitive topics.

source_families.label: LEHD/LODES, ACS, and decennial Census
source_families.notes: LODES 2002-2022; ACS 1-year 2005-2024; ACS 5-year 2009-2024; decennial APIs cover 2000, 2010, 2020.

source_families.label: DOF sales, valuations, and rent context
source_families.notes: Annual sales updates plus property valuation/assessment; rents from triennial NYC HVS and RGB research.

source_families.label: OpenStreetMap and ohsome history
source_families.notes: Use as mapped-change evidence with explicit OSM caveats.

data_availability.summary: NYC is the first US Open Citylog atlas city. The generated public artifacts include partial row-level events from DOB, DOT street permits, ZAP, permitted events, 311, collisions, and curated milestones, plus broader catalog-level source markers for remaining families.
